purpose.domain_detail: ACAS (Applewood Computers Accounting System) Purchase Invoice RDB Data Access Layer handler; manages two MySQL tables (PUINVOICE-REC header and PUINV-LINES-REC line items) on behalf of the flat-file handler module acas026.
purpose.summary: This program is a MySQL RDB Data Access Layer (DAL) module for the ACAS accounting system, handling purchase invoice records across two relational tables (header and line items). It is called by the COBOL flat-file handler acas026 and translates file-style operations (open, close, read, write, rewrite, delete, start) into embedded SQL statements via a JC preSQL preprocessor. It manages cursor-based sequential reads, indexed reads, inserts, updates, and deletes for both the primary invoice header table and the invoice line-item table.
